gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with pathological diagnosis of glioblastoma at first surgery (WHO Grade IV, supratentorial location);

candidate_evidence.quote: [DEVICE] Tumor Electric Fields Treatment System (other names: ASCLU-300)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: This early phase I trial will investigate the safety and feasibility of applying the Tumor Electric Fields Treatment System to subjects with recurrent glioblastoma.

coder_notes: Device-only (tumour treating fields) single-arm Early Phase 1 study; no drug or biologic interventions. Exclusion reason could alternatively be no_pharmacological_candidate; chose excluded_intervention_type because devices are listed as an excluded intervention type in manual 1.2.
